provenance.note: Decoration only, conformed to the park_crown bake; rebuild after a re-bake. Procedural, authored in this repository from Blender bmesh sheets and solids; no external mesh. No -col mesh: the stamped terrain stays the only collider. a cracked mud floor of polygon plates with dark seams, a cut bank of banded strata under a grey cap, bleached driftwood, root balls, rusted corrugated sheet and pipe sections half-buried against the banks, gravel bars on the inside of bends.
Decoration only. Detail shell 1 of liner_west_wash, drawn by range (the detail class): pebbles.
Decoration only. Detail shell 2 of liner_west_wash, drawn by range (the detail class): crack lips and curled flakes.
